name: Fenmark ToughSeam Electrician Pant
description: Slim-straight work trousers designed for electrical and systems technicians who work in tight conduit spaces and equipment bays. The fabric is a matte black anti-static weave that dissipates minor static charge. Flat-front, no metal hardware anywhere on the garment. Two slim thigh pockets sized for a diagnostic tablet and tool set. A narrow but recognizable category of workwear.
functionality: Anti-static fabric construction, non-conductive hardware throughout
what_it_says: You're a systems tech or electrician — a skilled trade that pays better than raw labor, and you have the specific gear to prove it.
story_hooks: Anti-static work trousers are required PPE in several high-voltage districts — someone wearing Fenmarks has legitimate reason to be near sensitive electrical infrastructure.
The non-conductive construction makes these useful in contexts beyond their intended purpose; a few street-level operators buy them specifically for that reason.
